meta.title: Add missing dockerignore
meta.body_summary: Add .dockerignore files for projects with Dockerfiles to improve build performance and security by excluding unnecessary files from Docker context.

perf_labels.notes: Straightforward addition of .dockerignore files to six projects; no performance evidence required and merged quickly after bot overview and human approval.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2814 changed lines, this is medium-sized by absolute volume, but the actual performance change is 372 lines across six .dockerignore files; the rest are merge-main artifacts. It fits a small, low-risk improvement that was quickly approved and merged.

review_details.concern_detail: No blocking review concerns were raised; the bot gave a non-blocking overview and the human maintainer approved without comment.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve Docker build performance and security by excluding unnecessary files from the build context.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding .dockerignore files is a straightforward build configuration task; the agent generated consistent exclusion patterns across multiple projects with no friction.

detection_detail.code_reading: The human maintainer approved without comment, implying acceptance of the .dockerignore patterns by visual inspection.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after build performance metrics were provided; the performance claim relies on general Docker best practices.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions are introduced; the change only adds new configuration files.

core_change_summary.description: Added .dockerignore files to six project directories (bank_subscription_prediction, huggingface-sagemaker/gradio, magic-photobooth, nightwatch-ai, retail-forecast, zenml-support-agent) with standard patterns to exclude version control, Python caches, build artifacts, and IDE files from the Docker build context.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The merge commit from main brought in many unrelated project and CI changes; these files are not part of the .dockerignore performance improvement.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (14b81d6) added six .dockerignore files with standard exclusion patterns.
Merge commit (3a3914e) integrated main branch with many unrelated changes.
